name: 21228 · Catonsville, MD
findings: ZIP 21228 (Catonsville) has 243 nonprofit organizations. 108 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 90 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 21228 (Catonsville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
